categories.title: Bell
categories.info: Touch the Bell to restore HP and Medicine. The first touch reveals new areas on the map.

categories.title: Sha-Chi Amber

categories.info: Find four Blackstone Shards to permanently increase Attack and Guard Break by 10%

categories.title: Memory Flower
categories.info: Collect all Memory Remnants to increase HP

categories.title: Book
categories.info: Books also give some Remnant Dust when collected.

categories.title: Soul Tempering Material
categories.info: Used to Soul Temper specific Phantom Edges. Some materials are fragmented and must have all their pieces gathered first.

categories.title: Traversal Talisman
categories.info: When away from a Bell, consume this Talisman to travel to any previously rung Bell.

categories.title: Weapon Reforge Talisman

categories.info: Used to restore a Phantom Edge to its initial level.
